game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · B and Unix
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 10: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about B and Unix.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Underground River'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Reach the rope bridge using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The rope bridge reached with actions_used <= 11.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the rope bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Underground River Trial
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
